sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: No statement (no alphabet note). Orthographic evidence only: acute accent written on ~5.7% of polysyllabic tokens; on native words almost always word-final (ijkón 1515x, ijkuakón 700, oksé 432, oyáj 323, kiné 268, opéj 257, nekáj 136, ijkín 97); penult/antepenult marks are Spanish names/loans or hiatus (patíoj) — consistent with the ILV convention of marking only non-penultimate stress (my inference).
